text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Conjunctivitis and Cutaneous Dissemination (Disseminated Gonococcal Infection). The history of maternal gonorrhea, sudden onset of a generalized pustular rash in a 4-day-old, and lack of prenatal care strongly support this. I have ordered a Gram stain and CBC; pending results will guide specific antibiotic therapy, but immediate treatment with ceftriaxone is indicated.
